subject: Renewal groundwork — staffing constraints, term options, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novabio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal groundwork — staffing constraints, term options, and QBR scheduling

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we start the formal renewal conversation for Q1, I wanted to capture a few constraints and suggest concrete next steps so we can lock the timeline. High-level notes below: 

- Current contract term ends 2026-03-31; Procurement indicated they want a single-year vs. multi-year decision before EOY if possible.
- I heard there are staffing constraints on your side (procurement + security) through mid-December. If that is still true, we should surface minimal legal/technical items now so we can still run an exec QBR in the first half of January.
- NovaBio is also considering a modest throughput uplift (+20–30%) and a short-term burst option for seasonal demand in Feb–Mar. We should incorporate capacity forecasts into the mutual action plan.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Can you confirm who on your procurement/security side will need to review contract language? If procurement is limited this week, is procurement@novabio.com the right delegate?
2) Proposed QBR windows (pick two):
   - Week of Jan 12 (preferred): Jan 13 or Jan 15, 60 minutes (exec + ops + procurement)
   - Week of Jan 20 (fallback): Jan 21 or Jan 22, 60 minutes
3) I'll attach a first-pass Mutual Action Plan and a capacity forecast template — please fill capacities and staffing availability where possible. 

Attachments: renewal-draft-MAP.pdf (application/pdf) — first pass, redlines welcome

If we can confirm attendees and a QBR slot by Friday 12/12, my team will prioritize a short legal readout so procurement has minimal redlines to process.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0147

---
Note: follow-up items for internal team: Marissa — can you prepare a 2-slide capacity delta (current vs +30%)? David — can you price a 1-yr vs 2-yr commit band with burst add-on?

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novabio.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novabio.com
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal groundwork — staffing constraints, term options, and QBR scheduling

Thanks Neha —

Quick reply: procurement bandwidth is indeed light this week; procurement@novabio.com is the right place to loop in. Our legal lead (Priya S.) is out until 12/18, so any heavy legal review likely won't move until then. That said, we can agree on commercial guardrails before EOY as long as the QBR is early Jan.

For QBR windows, Jan 13 works best for me (morning PT). We can aim for 9:30–10:30 PT on Jan 13 — I will confirm with the rest of the cross-functional team.

On capacity: we'll fill the attached MAP with expected peak requests/week and note the seasonal burst target we mentioned.

Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Ops, NovaBio Therapeutics
elena@novabio.com | (650) 555-2222

Subject: Fwd: Renewal groundwork — staffing constraints, term options, and QBR scheduling

Team — forwarding Elena's note and confirming the QBR preference: Jan 13, 9:30–10:30 PT. Action items below before I send a calendar invite to Elena and procurement@novabio.com: 

- Marissa: please prepare the capacity delta slide (2 slides max) and fill the attached capacity-forecast-dec2025.csv with current baseline + projected + burst assumptions. Attach to the invite.
- David: please run pricing scenarios for 1-yr vs 2-yr commits and a burst add-on (assume +20% and +30% throughput tiers); include suggested fallback language for procurement to reduce legal back-and-forth.
- I'll draft a tight QBR agenda: 10 min exec summary, 20 min capacity & ops implications, 20 min commercial/pricing, 10 min action items + next steps.

I'll aim to send the invite by EOD Thursday 12/11 with the MAP and capacity CSV attached. If Priya S. (legal) remains out, we should surface the commercial guardrails up front so procurement can circulate without heavy redlines.

Attachments: capacity-forecast-dec2025.csv (text/csv)

Thanks — Neha
